author: Astro77
quote: It’s not just that the protagonists Jason and Lucia are boring, or that she is obnoxious and toxic, or the fact he’s just as interesting as a wet cardboard box…It’s that the story around them is ridiculous. Her leaving the baby at the coffee shop to RANDOMLY rob a place, him finding out about the baby and being okay with her going to prison, and then wanting to make it work..throughout the game she shows MULTIPLE signs and red flags to get away. Some of the side content and activities are incredibly cringe as well. The dialogue is wack to a point where you find yourself physically cringing and taking the headphones off…The “villains” and important characters are very luke warm..most of them have little interesting about them. The game looks nice graphically to a degree, but so do dozens of other games. Big deal? Also, the performance on these consoles, late in their life span is a joke as well. Honestly it’s a let down, I saw it coming though. We all know the type of people who now work for this company, we knew they would destroy it. At this point, we are all use to it. Mid game, decent graphics for a console, pathetic performance aside.

author: Astro77
quote: Yeah this game is unplayable. The bugs are beyond annoying. Trying to play career mode is a joke. I’ve turned this game off separate times due to game breaking bugs. What a joke for Microsoft. Honestly tired of lazy developers. Also, what’s the deal with the “passengers” you fly and their CRINGE AI Millennial dialog. It’s uncomfortably cringe, I need to find a way to turn it off.. Character creator is also an ugly joke.

author: Astro77
quote: Childish, upside down game. Idk why people would want to play this. Tried it both on my Xbox and PC. Miserable. All of this agenda pushing is awful. The world in this game is unbelievable, it’s SO hard to follow along with the story with these childish goofy characters and companions. What kind of RPG is this game? A gross one, minus the RPG elements. Who won the election btw?
